summary: This project README describes a 5,000-episode Deep Q-Network training run for Ms. Pac-Man. The mean score over five evaluation games rose from 492 for the untrained network to 1,342 after training, and raising the replay buffer from 5,000 to 2,500,000 is what turned a flat training curve into a rising one.
key_facts: The agent's mean score over five evaluation games rose from 492 to 1,342.
A 5,000-episode run was conducted using 3,557,262 decisions and 889,066 updates.
The replay buffer capacity was increased from 5,000 to 2,500,000 transitions.
The training run took 127.7 minutes on Apple Silicon MPS.
A 30-seed validation harness was used to measure performance more reliably than the official five-game evaluation.
The agent's mean survival increased from 589 to 901 decisions per game.
The training run reached a peak memory usage of 86 GiB.
The agent's performance was evaluated using a fixed 5% exploration rate during evaluation.

concepts.name: Deep Q-Network
concepts.definition: A method that trains a neural network to estimate the future points each action is worth, learning from sampled past experience against a periodically refreshed target network.
concepts.in_this_source: The project uses a Deep Q-Network architecture with 3 convolutional layers and 2 dense layers.

concepts.name: Experience Replay
concepts.definition: A technique to break correlation between consecutive frames by sampling random batches of past experiences.
concepts.in_this_source: The author increased the replay buffer capacity to 2,500,000 to reduce correlation and improve learning.

concepts.name: Hyperparameters
concepts.definition: Settings that control the behavior and learning process of a reinforcement learning agent.
concepts.in_this_source: The author set exploration 0.20, episodes 5,000, and learning rate 0.0001, and separately changed the fixed classroom settings REPLAY_CAPACITY (5,000 to 2,500,000) and DEMO_EVERY (25 to 125).

concepts.name: PyTorch
concepts.definition: An open-source machine learning library used for building and training neural networks.
concepts.in_this_source: The project uses PyTorch 2.14.0 for the agent's implementation.

concepts.name: Winner's Curse
concepts.definition: Picking the best of many noisy measurements inflates its score, so the winner underperforms on fresh data.
concepts.in_this_source: The validation-best checkpoint scored 1,173.3 on validation seeds but 912.0 on the official five, so the author submitted the final network instead.
